hero_desc: A platform designed to manage, organize, and enjoy music libraries from any device. Developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the web version and Android Studio for the mobile app, sharing a common infrastructure based on Firebase.
descripcionJustificacion: Why was AudiHub created and what problems does it solve?
card1JustificacionDes: This project was created with the goal of providing a centralized digital solution related to hearing health that allows optimizing the manual processes of saving audiometries, managing appointments, and tracking patients, thereby facilitating the work of professionals while simultaneously offering patients access to their hearing information.
card2JustificacionDes:
It consists of two platforms:
A mobile application for patients and a website for medical professionals.

Through a shared backend powered by Firebase, audiometry results, medical appointments, and patient follow-ups are instantly synchronized on both the web and mobile devices.
card3JustificacionDes:
With the goal of ensuring optimal accessibility, the design was developed considering the needs of people with different types of color blindness, aiming to select an accessible color palette and avoiding problematic combinations.

Additionally, it is accessible to users from different language backgrounds: Galician, Spanish, and English.
card4JustificacionDes:
Aimed at two main user profiles:

On one hand, hearing care professionals using the website.
On the other hand, patients using the mobile application.
funcionalidadesDes: AudiHub consists of two applications sharing the same infrastructure, offering features tailored to the needs of each platform.
funcionalidadesWebTitutlo: Main features of the web application
funcionalidadesWeb1: User authentication: access via username and password
funcionalidadesWeb2: Audiometry recording and storage: creation of new records associated with each patient
funcionalidadesWeb3: Appointment management: scheduling, editing, and canceling medical appointments
funcionalidadesGenerales1: Information synchronization between the web and mobile applications
funcionalidadesGenerales2: Encryption and protection of stored data
funcionalidadesGenerales3: Ability to incorporate new features in the future
funcionalidadesMovilTitutlo: Main features of the mobile application
funcionalidadesMovil1: Registration and sign-in: account creation, login, and password recovery
funcionalidadesMovil2: Audiometry history consultation: viewing recorded results by the professional along with their report
funcionalidadesMovil3: Appointment request and consultation: requesting new appointments and accessing the personal calendar
funcionalidadesMovil4: Accessible interface: clear visual design, use of icons and adapted text to facilitate usage for people with hearing difficulties
ecosistemaWeb3: Used by medical staff for creating, editing, and deleting audiometries, along with managing appointments
ecosistemaMovil1: Mobile interface adapted for different types of color blindness and accessible in multiple languages (Galician, Spanish, and English)
ecosistemaMovil3: Registration of audiometries and reports, and appointment consultation
